q: When is the piano tuner coming?

Robin fait 1m71, je viens de vérifier discrètement !

Altanka to świetny prezent, Robin marzy o niej od lat.

I'll have the kids that night, no problem. I'll tell Robin I simply missed them. N x

Our Robin with a horse again after twenty years. I nearly told on the phone yesterday.

why: Whereabouts give away a horse

q: Quel jour vient l'électricien pour la véranda ?

why: The service hides a present

Per il regalo di Robin siamo in nove, venti euro a testa.

why: The cellar holds a present
